source: Statistics South Africa, National Household Travel Survey (NHTS) 2020
hash: not computed -- no local microdata access this session
age_universe: Not filtered or discussed at all -- GAP. Neither the traveller subsample (Q47Travlooking==Yes, n=4655) nor the wage subsample (n=20867) has any age restriction applied or reported.
labour_market_universe: Job seekers who travelled while looking for work (Q47Travlooking==Yes), a narrower population than the expanded labour force -- NOT the same universe as discouraged_share/long_term_share
denominator: Numerator: mean daily cost over 4,655 travellers. Denominator: median monthly wage (Q410Salary/21.7) over ~20,867 respondents with a valid wage AND pay period -- a GENERAL population wage benchmark, not a job-seeker-specific one (job seekers have no wage by construction)
conditioning_event: Numerator conditions on Q47Travlooking==Yes, a single reported travel day; the cost is for that day only, not a monthly or per-trip average
weights: NHTS person-level Weight, applied to the cost side and the wage side independently (not jointly)
missingness_treatment: Per-mode cost fields (Q429b3Cost1..Q432b3Cost4): both the Unspecified (refused/missing) and Not-applicable (mode not used) categories are treated identically as a zero contribution to total_cost. This does not distinguish a genuine non-user from a traveller who used a mode but did not report its cost.
units: ratio of a day-conditional transport cost to one day's wage (dimensionless)
estimator: ratio of two independently-weighted point estimates
uncertainty_method: Nonparametric bootstrap (2,000 resamples), cost and wage populations resampled independently each draw. No cluster/PSU adjustment attempted or its absence checked for NHTS specifically.
model_counterpart: src/moments.py transport_budget_share() -- total transport spend over total effective search trips in a window, divided by the daily wage
open_audit_findings: (1) The Unspecified/Not-applicable conflation in cost missingness is unresolved and could bias mean_daily_cost downward if some Unspecified respondents incurred real, unreported costs. (2) No age restriction has been applied or even diagnosed for this moment, unlike the two QLFS moments. (3) No design-effect/clustering check has been run for NHTS specifically.
